notes: Task 046 Phase 0 probes, written before any selector code existed (2026-11-14). Every target is an earlier exchange outside the thread window. Each target has two hard distractors using its own vocabulary, three needs-history probes that share at least one search form with it (lexical), one needs-history probe that shares none (paraphrase, an honest miss for a lexical selector), and one related probe that touches the topic but does not need the old exchange. Probes alternate between the tuning half and the held-out half in file order; gates are read on the held-out half only. The benchmark checks the lexical/paraphrase labels mechanically.
